ARTICLE I
THE ASEAN SECRETARIAT
ESTABLISHMENT AND LOCATION
1. The Contracting Parties hereby establish a permanent Secretariat for
ASEAN which shall be called, the ASEAN Secretariat, hereinafter referred to as
"the Secretariat".
2. The Secretariat shall have its scat in Jakarta, Indonesia, hereinafter referred
to as "the Host Country".
